correctness.rationale: The 45-node characteristic-two configuration consists of fifteen two-support points and thirty paired-root points over F4. An independent exact F4 six-coordinate generator obtained those 45, enumerated all 13,950 noncollinear node triples, extracted precisely forty 9-node plane spans, and independently reconstructed the 45×40 integer incidence. Exact SymPy Smith form returned fifteen unit and ten factor-two entries, with rational rank 25 and mod2 rank 15. The source proof also establishes every nine-node plane lies on σ4=0 using coefficientwise polynomial expansion and identifies all geometric singular nodes via gradient case split and nondegenerate quadrics. Gram MMᵀ=8I+2A for SRG(45,32,22,24) gives rational rank25; explicit 25×25 minor of determinant -1024 and binary rank15 force exactly ten 2-torsion factors. Finite F4 enumeration is geometrically exhaustive because all node types and planes are separately algebraically classified, not because arbitrary point sampling suffices.

value.rationale: Integral saturation defects and exact torsion of canonical incidence lattices are natural invariants of this highly symmetric quartic. The ten order-two classes are invisible to the rational incidence rank; they provide exact arithmetic structure beyond known node and plane counts, without conflating incidence cokernel with Picard or divisor-class torsion.
